concerns.text: Task T013 (Principle VI amendment request) is placed **after** tasks that depend on the amendment (T007‑T012). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; the amendment must be recorded **before** any composition‑dependent analysis begins.

Task T002 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but modifies `code/utils/io.py`, a module imported by many downstream tasks. Running it in parallel with other tasks could cause import‑time race conditions, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T014 (`code/main.py` driver) is marked `[P]` yet orchestrates the entire pipeline and depends on all prior artifacts. It cannot safely run in parallel with any other task; the `[P]` tag is incorrect.

Task T015 generates figures from validated artifacts and therefore depends on the existence of those artifacts. Marking it `[P]` suggests it can run concurrently with its producers, which is not true.
Task T016 writes the methods & results section, referencing numerous artifacts produced earlier. It is not parallel‑safe; the `[P]` tag should be removed.
